description: «Match people» on a finished import: a Jira account → a member of the company. Everything that came under that account as a name — an empty assignee, the reporter and comment authors the importer stood in for, logged hours, person fields, @Name mentions — is put on the member; nobody is notified and no issue counts as changed. Some now and the rest later is fine: each call adds to what stands, and the matching is kept for the next run of the import. Each matching is a line in the company's journal. Answers with how many were 'mapped' and 'rewritten' — how many records moved, by kind. The company's administrator only.

people.description: Jira account → username of a member, as 'acc-1=anna, acc-2=bob'.
